mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_post (post_title, post_content, board_number, user_number, create_at, view_count) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{boardNumber}, #{userNumber}, now(), 0)
mapper.select: Select p.post_number, p.post_title, p.create_at, p.user_number, p.board_number, p.view_count, b.region_name, b.board_category_name, b.post_category_name from tb_post p join tb_board b on p.board_number = b.board_number ORDER BY create_at DESC

Select p.post_number, p.post_title, p.post_content, p.create_at, p.user_number, p.board_number, p.view_count, b.region_name, b.board_category_name, b.post_category_name, u.user_name, COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) AS recommend_count from tb_post p join tb_board b on p.board_number = b.board_number join tb_user u on p.user_number = u.user_number left join ( select post_number, COUNT(*) as cnt from tb_post_recommend group by post_number ) r on r.post_number = p.post_number where p.post_number = #{_parameter}
